subject: Future Tech
title: Sensor Fusion
description: A micro-lesson that makes Sensor Fusion usable.

hook.text: No single sensor is perfect. So AV companies fuse lidar, cameras, and radar together.

buildup.text: Lidar gives precise 3D shape. Cameras add color and text recognition. Radar provides velocity and weather penetration.

discovery.text: Sensor fusion merges these data streams into one coherent picture.

climax.text: Waymo's fifth-gen system uses 29 cameras, 6 lidar units, and 6 radar sensors, all fused by custom AI chips.

punchline.text: One sensor type is a guess. Three together is certainty.

quiz.question: What is sensor fusion?
options: Combining data from multiple sensor types into one picture
Using one sensor to replace all others
